answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own nebula record, and its own share of the fable quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The comet ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 4878 identities would post 3463 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
